analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has slightly increased from 39.7 to 46.2 but remains in the neutral zone. MACD histogram also improved from -1.2832 to -0.8503, but the improvement is marginal to confirm a trend reversal. The volume ratio of 0.64 compared to the 5-day average indicates a lack of directional conviction. The current price ($90.29) is below the SMA20 ($93.72) and SMA50 ($92.04), trading around the Bollinger Band middle line ($93.72). No clear buy or sell signals are detected, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($91.22)/SMA200 ($82.99): Mid-to-long-term trend above SMA200 but below SMA100, indicating potential for bearish shift.
· 52-week position (74.8%) + Current price range is a pullback zone from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.7→46.2) + Exited oversold, now consolidating in neutral zone + interpreted as lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2832→-0.8503) + Marginal improvement diagnosed + weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle line $93.72) + Bandwidth at 20.22% suggests moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line ($88.30) + Basis (below SMA5, above Pivot S1 ($83.25)).
· Swing resistance line ($92.14) + Expectation to re-enter SMA20/50 upon breach.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Consolidation) + Uncertainty of trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.64x) + Decreased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Entry condition: RSI recovery above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
